description.value:
Requirements You're in Bladework Stance and an enemy within your Favored Blade's first range increment has at least one copy of your Favored Blade stuck in them.

You recall all blades within your weapon's first range increment. Creatures take @Damage[(1d6+1)[persistent,bleed]] damage for each blade that was stuck in them, with a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against your soaring blade DC.
